title: Hook events: MCP elicitation
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: Elicitation, ElicitationResult.

hookEvent_Elicitation.title: Elicitation
hookEvent_Elicitation.description: When an MCP server requests user input mid-task; a hook can answer programmatically.

hookMatcherGroup_Elicitation.description: Matcher group for Elicitation: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the MCP server name. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test).
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.
hooks.title: Hooks

hookEvent_ElicitationResult.description: After a user responds to an MCP elicitation, before the response is sent to the server.
